ArtanisTwinBladesReactiveParry.name: Reactive Parry
ArtanisTwinBladesReactiveParry.description: Damaging enemy Heroes with Twin Blades or Blade Dash grants Artanis 50 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing its damage by 50%. Stores up to 2 charges.

ArtanisTwinBladesAmateurOpponent.name: Amateur Opponent
ArtanisTwinBladesAmateurOpponent.description: Twin Blades attacks deal 150% bonus damage to non-Heroes.

ArtanisProtectorOfAiur.name: Protector Of Aiur
ArtanisProtectorOfAiur.description: Quest: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase Artanis's Attack damage by 0.1%. Takedowns grant 1% bonus damage.

ArtanisPhasePrismPsionicSynergy.name: Psionic Synergy
ArtanisPhasePrismPsionicSynergy.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Phase Prism grants 30 Armor for 5 seconds.

ArtanisShieldOverloadShieldBattery.name: Shield Battery
ArtanisShieldOverloadShieldBattery.description: Shield Overload's cooldown recharges 125% faster while its Shield is active. Passive: Reduce Shield Overload's cooldown by 4 seconds.

ArtanisShieldOverloadShieldSurge.name: Shield Surge
ArtanisShieldOverloadShieldSurge.description: Increases Shield Overload's Shields by 80% while below 25% Health.

ArtanisBladeDashSolariteReaper.name: Solarite Reaper
ArtanisBladeDashSolariteReaper.description: Increases the damage of the first dash of Blade Dash by 175%.

ArtanisPhasePrismChronoSurge.name: Chrono Surge
ArtanisPhasePrismChronoSurge.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Phase Prism grants 40% bonus Attack Speed for 5 seconds and Slows the enemy's Movement Speed by 30% for 4 seconds.

ArtanisFinalCut.name: Final Cut
ArtanisFinalCut.description: After using an Ability, your next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 40% additional damage. While under 25% Health, this damage bonus is increased to 60%.

ArtanisHeroicAbilitySpearofAdunSuppressi.name: Suppression Pulse
ArtanisHeroicAbilitySpearofAdunSuppressi.description: Fire a large area pulse from the Spear of Adun, dealing 114 (+4% per level) damage and Blinding enemies for 4 seconds. Unlimited range.

ArtanisHeroicAbilitySpearofAdunPurifierB.name: Purifier Beam
ArtanisHeroicAbilitySpearofAdunPurifierB.description: Target an enemy Hero with an orbital beam from the Spear of Adun, dealing 184 (+4% per level) damage per second for 8 seconds. The beam will chase the target as they move. Unlimited range.

ArtanisBladeDashTemplarsZeal.name: Templar's Zeal
ArtanisBladeDashTemplarsZeal.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Blade Dash from 50 to 25. Each time that Shield Overload activates, reduce the cooldown of Blade Dash by 6 seconds.

ArtanisTwinBladesTripleStrike.name: Triple Strike
ArtanisTwinBladesTripleStrike.description: Increases Twin Blades's number of Basic Attacks to 3, but increase its cooldown by 1 second.

ArtanisPhasePrismGravitonVortex.name: Graviton Vortex
ArtanisPhasePrismGravitonVortex.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Phase Prism from 50 to 25. Hitting an enemy Hero with Basic Attacks or Blade Dash reduces the cooldown of Phase Prism by 2 seconds.

ArtanisShieldOverloadPhaseBulwark.name: Phase Bulwark
ArtanisShieldOverloadPhaseBulwark.description: Shield Overload grants 50 Spell Armor while active and for 2 seconds after it expires.

ArtanisTwinBladesTitanKiller.name: Titan Killer
ArtanisTwinBladesTitanKiller.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 0.5% of the target's maximum Health in damage, increased to 1.5% when empowered by Twin Blades.

ArtanisShieldOverloadForceofWill.name: Force of Will
ArtanisShieldOverloadForceofWill.description: Casting Basic Abilities reduces the cooldown of Shield Overload by 5 seconds.

ArtanisTwinBladesBladesofaTemplar.name: Blades of a Templar
ArtanisTwinBladesBladesofaTemplar.description: Increase Attack Speed by 20%. Basic Attacks Slow by 20% for 1.25 seconds.

ArtanisSpearofAdunSuppressionPulseOrbita.name: Orbital Bombardment
ArtanisSpearofAdunSuppressionPulseOrbita.description: Suppression Pulse gains an additional charge. There is a 10 second cooldown between uses.

ArtanisSpearofAdunPurifierBeamTargetPuri.name: Target Purified
ArtanisSpearofAdunPurifierBeamTargetPuri.description: Increase the speed of Purifier Beam by 15%. If the target of Purifier Beam dies, it automatically recasts on the nearest visible enemy Hero.

ArtanisTwinBladesZealotCharge.name: Zealot Charge
ArtanisTwinBladesZealotCharge.description: Increase Twin Blades' charge distance by 75%.

ArtanisPlasmaBurn.name: Plasma Burn
ArtanisPlasmaBurn.description: While Shield Overload is active, deal 70 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.
